_comment: Accepted Semgrep findings (contrib/semgrep/README.md, 'Accepting a finding'). findings: fingerprint -> {rule, path, reason, by, date}. rule_paths: [{rule (glob), paths (globs), reason, by, date}]. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

fc5d4dd2a0fb4f4b.reason: Inside #[cfg(test)] mod tests (finds_regtest_subdir): a per-process scratch directory holding a dummy cookie, removed at the end of the test. Not in the shipped binary.

ff83bc119503a1f1.reason: Inside #[cfg(test)] mod tests (recorder_appends_and_flushes): a per-process scratch directory for a recorded session. Not in the shipped binary.

rule_paths.reason: Integration tests create per-process scratch directories under the OS temp dir; the server itself never does.

The UI uses no jQuery (no dependency, no build step). `$` is a local document.getElementById alias (e.g. ui/panels/events.js:8) and `.append` is the DOM Element.append, which inserts strings as text nodes, not HTML. HTML sinks are covered by chainviz.ui.html-sink.
